How to use Military Honey

A simple daily routine, with a few safety notes.

Daily routine

  1. Read the label. Check serving size and ingredients on your bottle.
  2. Take as directed. Follow the label serving; do not exceed it.
  3. Stay consistent. Take it at the same time each day.
  4. Keep healthy habits. Water, sleep and activity matter most.
  5. Store properly. Keep cool, dry and away from children.

Before you start

Talk to a doctor first if you take prescription medication (especially nitrates or blood pressure drugs), have heart or blood pressure conditions, are under 18, or are unsure. Stop use and seek advice if you feel unwell. Health authorities have warned that some products sold for male performance have contained undeclared drug ingredients, so buy only from the official source and read the label.
